# From ore to yellowcake
- Leaching: Uraninite Dust + 250 mB Sulfuric Acid in the Chemical Reactor gives 250 mB Uranyl Sulfate Solution.
- Precipitating: 250 mB Uranyl Sulfate Solution + 50 mB Ammonia gives Ammonium Diuranate.
- Calcining: Ammonium Diuranate in the Induction Furnace (or any furnace) gives Yellowcake.

# Fluorine
- Hydrofluoric Acid: Fluorite Dust + 500 mB Sulfuric Acid in the Chemical Reactor gives 500 mB. It burns like the other acids.
- Fluorine: 100 mB Hydrofluoric Acid in the Electrolyzer gives 50 mB Hydrogen and 50 mB Fluorine (out of its oxygen side).

# Conversion
All in the Chemical Reactor:
- Yellowcake + 100 mB Hydrogen: Uranium Dioxide.
- Uranium Dioxide + 400 mB Hydrofluoric Acid: Uranium Tetrafluoride (green salt).
- Uranium Tetrafluoride + 100 mB Fluorine: 100 mB Uranium Hexafluoride (UF₆), at the natural 0.711% U-235.
One Uraninite Dust makes 100 mB of UF₆.
